text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Pulmonary Veno-Occlusive Disease (PVOD) or Pulmonary Capillary Hemangiomatosis (PCH). The combination of severe dyspnea, orthopnea, normal chest imaging, normal cardiac workup, and a disproportionately low DLCO on pulmonary function tests is highly suggestive of a rare pulmonary vascular disorder. These conditions cause capillary obstruction leading to impaired gas exchange without the typical fibrosis seen in standard interstitial lung disease. I recommend a right heart catheterization to measure pulmonary capillary wedge pressure and confirm the diagnosis.
